column1: A Food Delivery Management System needs to handle different types of food orders. Every order must support a basic placeOrder() operation, so an interface named Order is created with this method. Some orders also support delivery tracking, so another interface named TrackableOrder extends the Order interface and adds a trackOrder() method. The OnlineFoodOrder and ExpressFoodOrder classes implement the TrackableOrder interface and provide their own implementations of both placeOrder() and trackOrder(). The system should validate the order type, customer name, order amount, and delivery distance before creating the appropriate object and displaying the order details. This scenario demonstrates interfaces, extending interfaces, implementation of inherited interface methods, and polymorphism in Java.
